breaking_news.headline: Trump says he is banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House
breaking_news.summary: The president chalked the ban up to what he called unfavorable coverage, and he threatened that bans on other media companies could be coming.

breaking_news.headline: How a pizza app changed our relationship with waiting
breaking_news.summary: Status trackers are ubiquitous on online apps and ordering. We have the story the seminal Domino's Pizza Tracker that led to many copies, and we check on why many of the trackers now aren't accurate.

breaking_news.headline: Ever wonder how the Fed's interest rate actually works? We've got answers
breaking_news.summary: The Federal Reserve just raised interest rates this week for the first time this year. So how does it actually work? And what does it mean for the economy — and the rest of us? Here are some answers.

breaking_news.headline: Judge orders Fox to hand over hundreds of documents in shareholders' case
breaking_news.summary: Fox Corp. must turn over hundreds of documents that could shed light on how founder Rupert Murdoch handled some of his media companies' biggest scandals.

breaking_news.headline: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sue Trump after being barred from White House
breaking_news.summary: Reporters from CNN, MS NOW and Politico say they were prevented from entering the White House grounds after President Trump announced plans to ban all three outlets.

breaking_news.headline: How a national farm leader is dealing with record diesel prices
breaking_news.summary: John Boyd Jr., president of the National Black Farmers Association, says soaring diesel costs are deepening a farm crisis as farmers face sharply higher fuel costs in the middle of harvest season.

breaking_news.headline: This farm raised thousands of pigs for slaughter. Now it's growing mushrooms instead
breaking_news.summary: The U.S. gets nearly a third of its pork from Iowa. One family is making the switch from pigs to more sustainable specialty mushrooms and trying to show other pig farmers how they did it.

breaking_news.headline: Paramount makes concessions to salvage $111 billion Warner Bros. Discovery deal
breaking_news.summary: Paramount's owners have made concessions to 12 Democratic state attorneys general to settle a lawsuit that endangered the media company's bid for its larger Hollywood rival, Warner Bros. Discovery.

breaking_news.headline: Four dead after powerful Typhoon Dujuan lashes Japan
breaking_news.summary: The storm pulled away from Japan after bringing heavy rains and strong winds to Tokyo and surrounding areas.

breaking_news.headline: Doctor in court to face Rwanda genocide charges in UK
breaking_news.summary: Dr Vincent Brown was charged following a seven year British investigation into the 1994 killings.

breaking_news.headline: Outrage in India over viral video of teen molested and her friend beaten
breaking_news.summary: Three minors were arrested after videos capturing the assault went viral in India, sparking anger.

breaking_news.headline: Sri Lankan court to deliver verdict on deadly Easter bombings
breaking_news.summary: Co-ordinated suicide attacks killed 270 people across several churches and hotels in Colombo in 2019.

breaking_news.headline: Eleven injured in shooting outside Turkish school
breaking_news.summary: Footage appears to show a male in the area carrying a firearm, while officials say the attacker has been captured.

breaking_news.headline: Iran must stop arming Houthis in Yemen, G7 says ahead of UN General Assembly
breaking_news.summary: The G7 also condemns "in the strongest terms" Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, saying that the escalation in fighting in Yemen jeopardises global energy security.

breaking_news.headline: Lithuania ready to 'fight back' but has evacuation plans in face of Russia threats, PM tells BBC
breaking_news.summary: Sinkevičius told BBC Newsnight Lithuanians feel "constantly threatened" by Moscow, but the nation was prepared to "fight back" if attacked.

breaking_news.headline: Major US outlets boycott shared Trump coverage in protest at media ban
breaking_news.summary: Regular coverage of the president has been disrupted after he banned CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House.

breaking_news.headline: Repeated air traffic control failures leave us in worrying territory
breaking_news.summary: The question is whether all of these incidents were isolated and unavoidable, or whether they point to something more systemic.

breaking_news.headline: Paramount settles lawsuit with US states, clearing way for $110bn merger with Warner Bros
breaking_news.summary: The deal includes an agreement to produce 30 films a year, or Paramount will be forced to sell off parts of its company.

breaking_news.headline: Spain battles climate change on several fronts
breaking_news.summary: A summer of wildfires and heatwaves underlines the threats to the country's economy.

breaking_news.headline: I'd rather pay thousands on a holiday: Meet the pensioners spending the kids' inheritance
breaking_news.summary: The phenomenon sees retirees spend all their money on enjoying life to the full.
